d:
"This track delves into Jxtt's growing fandom and the impact it's having. One fangirl is obsessively hooked on his music, going to extreme lengths to get his attention. While she's desperately stalking him, Jxtt is too caught up in his badmaash ways, living his life and staying unbothered."

Written & Performed By: Ghaint Jxtt
